@deskStatusFailover.description: Desktop title-bar status popover (Network or Node): row label; whether the wallet moves to another node when its node stops answering.

@deskStatusOn.description: Desktop status popover: value of the Failover row when the node failover setting is on.

@deskStatusHeight.description: Desktop Node status popover (Deep end level): row label; the node's block height.

@deskStatusVersion.description: Desktop Node status popover (Deep end level): row label; the node software's version.

deskStatusRecheckHint: If an amount looks wrong, the wallet reads the chain again.

@deskStatusRecheckHint.description: Desktop Settings › This wallet at the Shallow level: info text of the Recheck balance row, whose Open button opens the Recheck balance page.
